$comment: The checkpoints whose SHA-256 was computed from a downloaded copy (analysis/lazylabel/MODEL_MANIFEST.md, 'SHA-256 values'). 'npm run ai:models <id>' (lazylabel-models fetch <id>) downloads one after asking, checks its size and SHA-256, and only then writes its entry into the model folder's manifest.json. The service never reads this file and never downloads anything. A digest may only be added here after the file has been downloaded from its url and hashed locally.

models.name: MobileNetV3 small
models.source: no download of its own: torchvision's MobileNet_V3_Small_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1 saved as a state dict, which Find Archetypes needs (MODEL_MANIFEST.md)
